svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Use Case Diagram - Part 2" id="fairy_tale_use_case_part2"> <mxGraphModel dx="1051" dy="590" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1200" pageHeight="850" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data": "@startuml
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam monochrome false
skinparam handwritten false

skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor #2C3E50
 ArrowColor #2980B9
}

skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor #2C3E50
}

actor \"Козлёночек\n(Околдованный)\" as Goat
actor \"Алёнушка\" as Alenushka
actor \"Купец\" as Merchant
actor \"Слуга\" as Servant
actor \"Народ\" as People

rectangle \"Сказка: Сестрица Алёнушка и братец Иванушка\" {

 rectangle \"Тайна у реки и разоблачение\" {
 usecase \"UC16: Отпроситься на речку\" as UC16
 usecase \"UC17: Звать сестрицу на берегу\" as UC17
 usecase \"UC18: Отвечать братцу со дна реки\" as UC18
 usecase \"UC19: Искать козлёнка\" as UC19
 usecase \"UC20: Подслушать диалог у реки\" as UC20
 usecase \"UC21: Донести правду купцу\" as UC21

 UC20 .> UC17 : <<extend>>
 UC17 ..> UC18 : <<interacts>>
 }

 rectangle \"Спасение, расколдовывание и возмездие\" {
 usecase \"UC22: Собрать народ на спасение\" as UC22
 usecase \"UC23: Вытащить Алёнушку шёлковыми сетями\" as UC23
 usecase \"UC24: Снять камень и оживить ключевой водой\" as UC24
 usecase \"UC25: Кувыркнуться и расколдоваться\" as UC25
 usecase \"UC26: Привязать ведьму к коню и пустить в поле\" as UC26

 UC23 .> UC24 : <<include>>
 UC25 .> UC24 : <<extend>>
 }
}

' Связи акторов с прецедентами
Goat --> UC16
Merchant --> UC16
Goat --> UC17
Alenushka --> UC18
Servant --> UC19
Servant --> UC20
Servant --> UC21
Merchant --> UC21

Merchant --> UC22
People --> UC22
People --> UC23
People --> UC24
Goat --> UC25
People --> UC26

@enduml
